name: Ethereal Sheer Gown
description: a layered, ethereal outfit of sheer, frosted {{PRIMARY}} fabric over a matte underlayer, with delicate, {{ACCENT_SOFT}} glowing fiber-optic threads woven throughout; the fabric is secured on her shoulders and nothing is covering her head
notes: Cross-cutting wardrobe piece, reusable by any hero — embeds {{PRIMARY}}/{{ACCENT_SOFT}} so each hero renders in her own palette. Grounded in the experimental 'Elegant/Translucent' pattern found across Drakness/Drakneta/Drakniya/Draknora's archived final-scene prompts, with the specific colours parameterized instead of hardcoded (those were early experiments and didn't consistently match each hero's locked palette).
